auth.name: GoTrue
auth.description: GoTrue is a user registration and authentication API

checks.name: real server health and email-confirmation policy
server rejects a password shorter than the configured minimum
signup generates actual local confirmation mail and cannot sign in unverified
actual confirmation token verifies once and preserves the signup identity
duplicate signup cannot create another identity
password recovery consumes real generated mail and changes the same account
TOTP rejects wrong code then creates an actual AAL2 session
editable metadata cannot grant administration; protected provisioning requires verified MFA
real AAL2 session authorizes minimal admin directory; its prior AAL1 token remains denied
current-password validation does not downgrade verified MFA or change UID
seeded Google-only fixture can add a password with unchanged UID and saved rows
real email PKCE confirmation exchanges once with the original verifier and same identity
global sign-out revokes the real refresh session

source.deviation: CLI serve listener only: omit Linux SO_REUSEPORT and its unused Unix/syscall imports. Auth API, storage, mailer, validation and migrations remain official release source.

limitations: Local SMTP capture is not Brevo or real mailbox deliverability.
A seeded Google identity is not a genuine Google OAuth handshake.
API plus direct authenticated SQL is not a hosted PostgREST end-to-end test.
Temporary Windows listener adaptation means this is not the identical hosted binary.
Local PostgreSQL18 differs from hosted PostgreSQL17.
